Same app as v0.1.0, now packaged for more platforms, with an app icon.

| Platform | File | Needs | Tested |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| macOS, Apple silicon | `RepoFind-0.1.1-macos-arm64.zip` | macOS 14+ | CI, plus a local build of the same code launched by hand |
| macOS, Intel | `RepoFind-0.1.1-macos-x86_64.zip` | macOS 14+ | CI only |
| Linux x86_64 | `RepoFind-0.1.1-linux-x86_64.tar.gz` | glibc 2.39+, GTK 4.14+ (Ubuntu 24.04 or later) | CI only |
| Linux arm64 | `RepoFind-0.1.1-linux-arm64.tar.gz` | glibc 2.39+, GTK 4.14+ | CI only |
| Windows x86_64 | `RepoFind-0.1.1-windows-x86_64.zip` | Windows 10 1809+ | CI only |

**"CI only" means the type check and headless tests pass on that platform and the package builds there — nobody has opened the app on it yet.** That is why this is a pre-release. If you try one, an issue saying whether scanning works would be very welcome.

Each file has a `.sha256` next to it.

## Install

- **macOS**: unzip, move `RepoFind.app` to Applications. The build is ad hoc signed and not notarized; clear the quarantine flag once: `xattr -dr com.apple.quarantine /Applications/RepoFind.app`
- **Linux**: `tar xzf RepoFind-0.1.1-linux-x86_64.tar.gz`, then run the `RepoFind` executable inside the extracted directory
- **Windows**: unzip and run `RepoFind.exe`. It is not code signed, so SmartScreen warns on first launch ("More info" → "Run anyway")

Then open Settings, set your scan roots and embedding endpoint, and press **SCAN + INDEX**.

## Changes since v0.1.0

- App icon
- Builds for Intel Macs, Linux and Windows, produced by a release workflow
- Backslash paths are accepted in scan roots

和 v0.1.0 是同一个应用，新增了应用图标和更多平台的安装包（见上表）。

**标注 "CI only" 的平台只保证类型检查、无头测试和打包在该平台通过，还没有人在上面实际打开过应用**，所以这一版标为 pre-release。如果你试了，欢迎提 issue 说一下扫描是否正常。

安装：macOS 解压后拖进"应用程序"，并执行一次 `xattr -dr com.apple.quarantine /Applications/RepoFind.app`；Linux 解压后运行目录里的 `RepoFind`（需要 glibc 2.39+、GTK 4.14+）；Windows 解压后运行 `RepoFind.exe`（未签名，SmartScreen 会提示，点"更多信息 → 仍要运行"）。
